cohort: 200 pregnant women undergoing caesarean section at GMERS Medical College, Sola, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India from October 2020 to October 2021, including 74 primary LSCS and 126 with > 1 previous LSCS.
finding: Repeat caesarean sections (specifically >2 previous LSCS) were associated with a statistically significant increase in intra-operative complications (bladder injury, uterine dehiscence, extension of uterine incision, and morbidly adherent placenta) compared to primary LSCS and 1 previous LSCS.
